board: MPBSE (Madhya Pradesh Board of Secondary Education)
subject: Vigyan (Science)

units_or_chapters.name: Manav Netra evam Rang Biranga Sansar

chapters.name: Rasayanik Abhikriyaen evam Samikaran
topics: Rasayanik parivartan ki paribhasha aur udaharan
Rasayanik samikaran ko santulit karna (balancing)
Samyojana abhikriya (Combination) — A + B → AB
Viyojan abhikriya (Decomposition) — AB → A + B
Visthapan abhikriya (Displacement) — A + BC → AC + B
Dvi-visthapan abhikriya (Double displacement) — AB + CD → AD + CB
ऑक्सीकरण (Oxidation) aur Apachayan (Reduction) — Redox reactions
Ushmaakshephi (Exothermic) aur Ushmaashoshi (Endothermic) reactions
Avkshepan abhikriya (Precipitation reaction)
Bhautik parivartan vs Rasayanik parivartan

chapters.name: Aml Kshaar evam Lavan
topics: Litmus test — aml (red litmus → blue nahi karta), kshaar (blue litmus → red nahi karta)
pH scale — 0-14. pH < 7 = aml, pH = 7 = udaseen, pH > 7 = kshaar
pH aur tooth decay ka sambandh
Udasineekharan abhikriya (Neutralisation): Acid + Base → Salt + Water
Common salts: NaCl, Na2CO3 (dhone ka soda), NaHCO3 (baking soda), CaOCl2 (bleaching powder), CaSO4·½H2O (plaster of paris)
Ubhayadharmi oxide (Amphoteric oxide) — e.g. Al2O3
Aml varsha (Acid rain) — kaaran aur prabhav
Strong acids vs weak acids
Sirke mein acetic acid, cheetiyon ke dank mein formic acid

chapters.name: Dhatu evam Adhatu
topics: Dhatu ke gun: vidyut chalakta, tapiya chalakta, aaghatwardhaniyata (malleability), tanyta (ductility), chaamdaar (lustrous), kathor
Adhatu ke gun: bhangur (brittle), vidyut kuchaalak (mostly), matt look
Apvad: Mercury (liquid dhatu), Bromine (liquid adhatu), Graphite (vidyut chalak adhatu), Diamond (kathor adhatu)
Reactivity series (sabse upar = Na, K, Ca; sabse neeche = Au, Pt)
Dhatu aur aml ki pratikriya — hydrogen gas nikalta hai
Jang (corrosion/rusting): Fe + O2 + H2O → Fe2O3.xH2O
Sangkaran (Alloy): Pittal = Cu+Zn, Kansy = Cu+Sn, Sitambar = Ag+Cu, Anya
Dhatu ka nishkasan: Khaniaj, Ayask, Gangu, Bhajan (Roasting), Nistapan (Calcination)
Nisthapan vs Bhajan
Galvanisation — zinc ki parat

chapters.name: Carbon evam Uske Yaugik
topics: Carbon ki visheshataen: Catenation, Tetravalency
Santrupt yaugik (Saturated) — sirf single bond — Alkanes (CnH2n+2)
Asantrupt yaugik (Unsaturated) — double/triple bond — Alkenes (CnH2n), Alkynes (CnH2n-2)
Homologous series (Sajaatiya shreni)
Prakaryatmak samooh (Functional groups): -OH (alcohol), -CHO (aldehyde), -COOH (carboxylic acid), -CO- (ketone)
Ethenol (Ethanol/Alcohol): C2H5OH — properties aur uses
Ethanoic acid (Acetic acid): CH3COOH — properties aur uses
Vikrit ethanol — denatured alcohol (poisonous banana)
Sabneekharan (Saponification) — sabun kaise banta hai
Santrupt carbon yaugik — sooty flame; Asantrupt — clean flame
IUPAC naming: methane, ethane, propane, butane...
Electron bindu sanrachana (Electron dot structure)

chapters.name: Jaiv Prakram
topics: Poshan: Swaposhi (Autotrophic) — photosynthesis; Vishamposhi (Heterotrophic)
Prakaash sanshleshan (Photosynthesis): 6CO2 + 6H2O → C6H12O6 + 6O2
Manav paachan tantra (digestive system) — organs aur functions
Shwasan (Respiration): oxidation process — energy release
Vaatav shwasan (Aerobic) vs Anaerobic respiration
Payruvet ka viyojan — mitochondria mein
Parivarhan (Transportation): Jlam (Xylem), Phloem, Heart, Blood
Manav hriday (Human Heart) ka chitr aur karya
Nephron — sanrachana aur kaarya
Uttejana (Excretion): manav utsarjan tantra
Stomata — khule aur band (open and closed stomatal pore)
Rakt aur Lasika mein antar (Blood vs Lymph)

chapters.name: Niyantran evam Samanvay
topics: Mastishk (Brain): Prastha mast (Cerebrum), Anumastishk (Cerebellum), Medulla
Pratighat chap (Reflex arc) — structure aur karyavidhi
Tantrakaoshika (Neuron) — sanrachana: dentrite, cell body, axon, synaptic knob
Synapse — do tantrika kooshikaon ke beech khaali jagah
Pituitary gland — master gland — growth hormone
Endocrine glands: Thyroid, Pancreas (insulin), Adrenal, Testes, Ovary
Hormones: Insulin (blood sugar), Adrenaline (emergency), Oestrogen, Testosterone
Padap hormones: Auxin (stem bending), Gibberellin (growth), Cytokinin, Abscisic acid
Phototropism, Geotropism (plant movements)

chapters.name: Jeev Janan Kaise Karte Hai
topics: Aling janan (Asexual): dvikhandan (binary fission), bahukhantan (multiple fission), mukulan (budding), beejanu (spore), punrudbhavan (regeneration), kayik pravardhan (vegetative propagation)
Ling janan (Sexual reproduction)
Manav nari janan tantra — parts aur functions
Manav nar janan tantra — parts aur functions
Parpagkaran (Pollination) — svapargkaran vs parapargkaran
Bhroon ko poshan — placenta ke dwara
Ritu sraav (Menstruation) — avadhi
Ling chromosome — XX (female), XY (male)
Sanchari rogo se bachav — condoms
Antriksh garbhanirodhakon (Contraceptive methods)
Tissue culture technique

chapters.name: Anuvamshikta
topics: Mendel ke prayog — matar ke poudhe
Mendel ke niyam: Pradhanta ka niyam (Law of Dominance), Prithakkaran ka niyam (Law of Segregation), Swatantra vyutkram ka niyam
F1 aur F2 peedhhi
Dominant aur recessive traits
Ling chromosome: XX (female), XY (male)
DNA ka poora naam — Deoxyribose Nucleic Acid
Gene — DNA ka woh bhaag jo protein sanshleshan ki soochna deta hai
Chromosomes ki sankhya manav mein — 46 (23 jode)

chapters.name: Prakash Paravarttan evam Apavarttan
topics: Praavarttan ke niyam (Laws of Reflection) — aapat kona = praavarttan kona
Samtal darpan (Plane mirror): focal length = infinity, image always virtual, erect, same size
Avtal darpan (Concave mirror): uses — torch, shaving mirror, solar furnace
Uttal darpan (Convex mirror): uses — rear view mirror in vehicles
Darpan sootra: 1/v + 1/u = 1/f
Sign convention: object hamesha left mein, distances measure from pole
Image formation by concave mirror — different positions
Apavarttan ke niyam (Laws of Refraction) — Snell's law
Apavartnaank (Refractive index): n = c/v = sin i / sin r
Lens formula: 1/v - 1/u = 1/f
Power of lens: P = 1/f (in metres), unit = Dioptre (D)
Dvi-uttall lens (Biconvex), Dvi-aval lens (Biconcave)
Numericals: mirror formula, lens formula, magnification, power

chapters.name: Manav Netra evam Rang Biranga Sansar
topics: Manav netra ki sanrachana: cornea, iris, pupil, lens, ciliary muscles, retina
Samanjana Kshamata (Power of accommodation) — ciliary muscles dwara focal length change
Nikatt drshti dosh (Myopia) — concave lens se theek hota hai
Door drshti dosh (Hypermetropia) — convex lens se theek hota hai
Jara drshti (Presbyopia) — bujurgon mein
Saphadh drshti (Normal vision) — near point 25 cm, far point = infinity
Prism se rang viksheapan (Dispersion by prism)
Varn vikshepan (Colour dispersion) — VIBGYOR
Rayleigh's scattering — nila aakaash
Taron ka timitimaana (Twinkling of stars) — atmospheric refraction
Graho ka nahi timitimaana (Planets don't twinkle)
Surya ka laal dikhna (sunrise/sunset)

chapters.name: Vidyut
topics: Vidyut dhara (Electric current): I = Q/t, SI unit = Ampere (A)
Vibhavantara (Potential difference): V = W/Q, SI unit = Volt (V)
Ohm's law: V = IR
Pratirodh (Resistance): R = V/I, SI unit = Ohm (Ω)
Pratirodhon ka sanyojan (Series aur Parallel combination)
Series: Rs = R1 + R2 + R3
Parallel: 1/Rp = 1/R1 + 1/R2 + 1/R3
Vidyut shakti (Electric power): P = VI = I²R = V²/R, unit = Watt (W)
Vidyut urja (Electric energy): E = Pt, commercial unit = kWh (unit)
Joule's heating effect: H = I²Rt
Fuse wire — laghu pathan se suraksha
Bhoo-sampark taar (Earth wire) — green wire
Live wire — red/brown, Neutral — black/blue
Laghu pathan (Short circuit) — causes aur effects
1 horsepower = 746 W

chapters.name: Vidyut Dhara ke Chumbakiya Prabhav
topics: Chumbakiya kshetra rekhaen (Magnetic field lines) — properties
Oersted ka prayog — current se magnetic field
Right hand thumb rule / Maxwell's corkscrew rule
Solenoid ka magnetic field
Electromagnetic induction (Faraday's principle)
Fleming's left hand rule — motor
Fleming's right hand rule — generator
Electric motor — vidyut urja → yantrik urja
Generator (Dynamo) — yantrik urja → vidyut urja
Bhoo-sampark taar (Earth wire) — suraksha
Fuse wire ki upyogita
Chumbakiya kshetra rekhaon ki visheshataen
Dakshin hast angushtha niyam — magnetic field direction around wire

chapters.name: Hamara Paryavaran
topics: Aahaar shrankhla (Food chain) aur Aahaar jaal (Food web)
Trophic levels — producer, primary consumer, secondary consumer, tertiary consumer
Manav — sarvahaaree (omnivore) hai ecosystem mein
Jaivik aavardhan (Biological magnification) — toxins ka trophic levels mein badna
Paryaavaran degradable vs Non-biodegradable waste
Ozone layer — CFC se khaatma
Manav paryavaran mein — sarvahaaree (omnivore) hota hai
Pehle trophic level ke jeev — producers (plants)

chapters_mostly_theory: Manav Netra evam Rang Biranga Sansar

tips: MCQ mein galat options eliminate karo — 2 toh clearly wrong hote hain
Balancing equations mein O aur H ko last mein balance karo
Diagram mein labels ZAROORI hain — bina labels diagram ke marks cut hote hain
Mirror formula mein sign convention sahi rakho — concave mirror ka f negative hota hai
Reaction types yaad rakho: CaO+H2O = exothermic; Fe2O3+2Al = displacement
Long answer mein diagram PEHLE banaao — 1 mark pakka
Objective mein sirf answer likhna hota hai — explanation time waste hai
Photosynthesis equation yaad karo — har saal aata hai
Common salts ke uses — baking soda, bleaching powder, plaster of paris — guaranteed
True/False mein agar doubt ho — science ke basic facts se milao
Match column carefully — extra options hote hain bhai, sab match nahi hote

time_allocation.note: 25 min — 30 marks ke liye. MCQ, fill blank, T/F, match, one word.
35 min — 12 marks. Diagram pehle, phir explanation.
20 min — question numbers check, labels dekho, MCQ review.

targets.strategy: Objective (Q1-Q5) mein 20+ marks + 2-3 short answers = 25+ marks
Objective max + 8-10 short answers + 1-2 medium answers
Objective max + Most short answers + All medium + 2 good long answers with diagrams

exam_day_rules.timetable_source: mpbse.nic.in par official timetable available hoti hai.

answer_sheet_rules: partial_note: Definition sahi + example galat — phir bhi definition ke marks milenge.
diagram_marks: Diagram ke liye alag marks hote hain. Sirf diagram nahi bana toh 1 mark cut.
labelling: Diagram mein labelling compulsory hai — labels missing ho toh marks cut.
MCQ_method: MCQ mein sirf (a)/(b)/(c)/(d) likhna kaafi hai — koi explanation nahi chahiye.

pen_rules.note: allowed: Blue aur Black pen pencil_use: Sirf diagrams aur rough work ke liye. Answers kabhi pencil se mat likho. diagram_pen_or_pencil: Pencil se diagram zyada neat hoti hai — recommended. Pen se bhi allowed.
